purpose: Separate the selected detector weight delta from changed prompt and thresholds in native video.
selection: No control selection. After choosing the adapted video admission margin on all nine development clips, run the original checkpoint with exactly the same hockey-player prompt, detection/output threshold, admission margin and runtime settings on all five reused regression clips.
comparison: Only the detector parameter delta differs between the adapted winner and matched original control.
limits: The original person-prompt pipeline remains a separate baseline. Reused sparse references do not establish continuous identity accuracy.
